source.title: Synthesis and Characterization of Nearly Monodisperse CdE (E = S, Se, Te) Semiconductor Nanocrystallites
source.authors: C. B. Murray, D. J. Norris & M. G. Bawendi

materials.name: Dimethylcadmium
materials.note: 0.250 μm filtration and vacuum transfer before use.

materials.name: Trioctylphosphine selenide
materials.note: Prepared by dissolving Se shot in TOP; subsequently diluted in solution B.

materials.name: Trioctylphosphine
materials.amount: 25.0 mL in A + 15.0 mL in B; also the TOPSe stock carrier
materials.note: Used as purchased. The solvent already in the TOPSe stock is additional to these two charges.

materials.name: Trioctylphosphine oxide
materials.note: Distilled fraction collected at 260–300 °C and ≈1 Torr. Reactor drying is a separate operation.

materials.name: Selenium shot
materials.amount: Mass not reported; stock adjusted to 1.0 M
materials.note: Electronic grade, 99.99+%. Dissolved in TOP before injection; not an elemental-Se injection.

materials.name: Argon
materials.note: No flow rate or drybox gas composition is specified.

auxiliaryMaterials.name: Methanol
auxiliaryMaterials.amount: 20 mL + 25 mL + 50 mL rinse per 10-mL reaction aliquot
auxiliaryMaterials.note: Anhydrous. Additional dropwise amount during size selection is not specified.

auxiliaryMaterials.name: 1-Butanol
auxiliaryMaterials.amount: 25 mL per 10-mL aliquot; size-selection volume unreported
auxiliaryMaterials.note: Anhydrous. Retain clear supernatant after removal of the gray byproduct.

auxiliaryMaterials.name: Pyridine
auxiliaryMaterials.amount: 5–10 mL for ≈50 mg capped crystallites in exchange
auxiliaryMaterials.note: Exchange at ≈60 °C. TEM uses a dilute pyridine dispersion; that concentration is unreported.

auxiliaryMaterials.name: Hexane
auxiliaryMaterials.amount: Excess for exchange; optical sample volume unreported
auxiliaryMaterials.note: Also an alternative size-selection pair with pyridine. Washed CdSe is dispersed in hexane for optical measurements.

auxiliaryMaterials.name: Chloroform
auxiliaryMaterials.note: Listed as an alternative chloroform/methanol pair; not an extra mandatory step.

stocks.name: TOPSe stock
stocks.amount: Se shot dissolved in sufficient TOP
stocks.description: The stock-preparation volume and Se mass are not specified. Elemental Se is converted to the named phosphine-selenide precursor before use.

stocks.name: Solution A
stocks.description: 13.35 mmol / 26.0 mL, assuming additive liquid volumes. Prepared in the drybox; measured final volume is not given.

stocks.name: Solution B
stocks.amount: 10.0 mL of 1.0 M TOPSe stock + 15.0 mL TOP
stocks.description: 10.00 mmol / 25.0 mL, assuming additive volumes. This is the diluted injection component, not the original 1.0 M stock.

stocks.name: Combined injection mixture
stocks.amount: Solution A + solution B, combined in the drybox
stocks.concentration: Nominal Cd 0.262 M; Se 0.196 M · calculated
stocks.description: Based on the 51 mL sum of component volumes. The paper describes a 50-mL syringe; the discrepancy is unresolved. Molecular panels show components separately and do not imply a measured complex.

synthesis.note: Method 1 · CdSe only. This sequence uses the original TOPSe route. CdTe, silyl-precursor Method 2 and pyridine surface exchange are separate procedures.

steps.title: Precursor preparation
steps.description: Prepare the 1.0 M TOPSe stock by dissolving electronic-grade selenium shot in TOP. The injected selenium reagent is TOPSe in solution, not a separate charge of Se shot. TOPO distillation and dimethylcadmium purification are separate preparative operations.

steps.title: TOPO drying and thermal stabilization
steps.description: Dry and degas the coordinating medium with periodic argon flushing. Then stabilize the bath near 300 °C under argon before injection.

steps.title: Preparation of solutions A and B
steps.description: Combine solutions A and B and load the mixture into the reported 50-mL syringe. The nominal component volumes add to 51 mL; the paper does not resolve that discrepancy. The amounts are preserved as written.
fields: 10.0 mL 1.0 M TOPSe (10.00 mmol) + 15.0 mL TOP

steps.title: Rapid precursor injection
steps.description: Remove the heat and deliver the combined precursor mixture in a single rapid injection through a rubber septum into vigorously stirred TOPO. The paper reports a yellow/orange solution and a sudden temperature drop.
fields: Single rapid injection; duration not specified

steps.title: Controlled growth and optical monitoring
steps.description: Restore heating and gradually raise the temperature. Monitor absorption every 5–10 minutes. Lower the temperature when the size distribution spreads; increase it when growth appears to stop. The authors describe a few hours of steady growth, not a fixed time for each size.
fields: A few hours; no fixed size–time schedule

steps.title: Aliquot withdrawal
steps.description: When the desired absorption characteristics appear, transfer a portion by cannula and store it in a vial. Method 1 reports a series of sizes from roughly 15 to 115 Å from one preparation. The purification procedure below begins with a 10-mL portion.

purification.note: Isolation and purification · all amounts below refer to a 10-mL reaction aliquot. Fraction identity matters: first keep the flocculate, then keep the clear liquid after removing gray byproducts.

steps.title: Aliquot cooling
steps.description: Remove a reaction aliquot by cannula and cool it to slightly above the melting point of TOPO. This is a sample workup, not the entire synthesis batch.

steps.title: Methanol flocculation
steps.description: Add anhydrous methanol to reversibly flocculate the nanocrystals. Separate the flocculate from the supernatant by centrifugation and retain the flocculate for redispersion.

steps.title: Byproduct separation
steps.description: Disperse the flocculate in anhydrous 1-butanol and centrifuge again. The nanocrystals remain in the optically clear supernatant; the gray precipitate contains mostly elemental Cd and Se byproducts and is discarded.

steps.title: Nanocrystal reflocculation
steps.description: Add anhydrous methanol to the retained clear supernatant to flocculate the nanocrystals again and remove excess TOP and TOPO.

steps.title: Methanol rinse and vacuum drying
steps.description: Rinse the flocculate with methanol and vacuum-dry it. The reported approximate product mass belongs to this 10-mL aliquot and includes the TOP/TOPO cap; it is not a whole-batch yield or a bare-CdSe mass.

sizeSelection.note: Size-selective precipitation · a separate refinement after purification. The paper gives an observed endpoint, not a fixed methanol volume or a universal number of cycles.

steps.title: Nanocrystal redispersion
steps.description: Disperse purified nanocrystals in anhydrous 1-butanol until the dispersion is optically clear.

steps.title: Size-selective precipitation
steps.description: Add anhydrous methanol dropwise until opalescence persists with stirring or sonication. Centrifugation separates a flocculate enriched in the largest crystallites from the remaining supernatant.

steps.title: Repeated fractionation
steps.description: Redisperse the precipitate in 1-butanol and repeat size-selective precipitation. Figure 1 illustrates a particular sample shifting from about 35 Å ±10% to 37 Å ±5%; it does not define a cycle count for every preparation.
fields: Separate Figure 1 example; not the TEM model

surfaceExchange.note: Optional surface exchange · a separate post-synthesis branch. It changes dispersibility and surface derivatization; it is not an obligatory step in Method 1 or Method 2.

steps.title: Pyridine dispersion and ligand exchange
steps.description: Heat TOP/TOPO-capped nanocrystals with excess pyridine to gradually disperse them. The paper does not specify an exact exchange duration or a measured bound-ligand composition.

steps.title: Hexane flocculation and recovery
steps.description: Add excess hexane, then isolate the flocculated crystallites by centrifugation. The hexane volume and centrifugation settings are not reported.

steps.title: Repeated surface exchange
steps.description: Repeat dispersion in pyridine and flocculation with hexane. The resulting crystallites disperse readily in pyridine, methanol and aromatic solvents, but no longer in aliphatic solvents.
fields: A number of times; exact count unreported

characterization.routeAssignment: Figure-specific specimens; exact route mapping not established.
